content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The reason this infrastructure works is that it's built on open-source technologies like GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers, which provide a scalable and secure foundation for your online store. By leveraging these technologies, you can create a fully functional ecommerce platform without relying on third-party services. This means you have complete control over your store and can make changes as needed, without being at the mercy of platform restrictions or fees.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure, you'll need a few key components. First, you'll need a domain name and a GitHub account to host your store. You'll also need to set up a Cloudflare account to manage your DNS and SSL certificates. Additionally, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account to enable crypto payments. With these components in place, you can start building your online store and deploying your infrastructure.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a critical step in deploying your sovereign commerce infrastructure. You'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your store to enable crypto payments, and set up a system for delivering digital products to customers. This can be done using Cloudflare Workers and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage. By automating your payment and delivery pipeline, you can ensure a seamless experience for your customers and reduce the administrative burden on your business.
Deploy your online store in just a few hours.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live with your store and start processing transactions. This is an exciting moment, as you'll be able to see your infrastructure in action and start generating revenue. To process your first transaction, simply add a product to your store, set a price, and wait for a customer to make a purchase. When a customer pays with crypto, NOWPayments will automatically verify the transaction and trigger the delivery of the digital product.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store grows and you start to generate more revenue, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to keep up with demand. This can be done by upgrading your Cloudflare plan, adding more storage to your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account, and optimizing your store for better performance. By scaling your infrastructure, you can ensure that your store remains fast and reliable, even as traffic and sales increase.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: set up a GitHub account and create a new repository for your store, set up a Cloudflare account and configure your DNS and SSL certificates, create a NOWPayments account and integrate it with your store, set up a system for delivering digital products to customers, and test your store to ensure everything is working correctly. With these steps complete, you can go live with your store and start selling ebooks and other digital products to a global audience.
